content.user_title: Draft Prisma Next Feedback for the Right Channel
content.value_statement: Prisma Next feedback can be difficult to classify and prepare for public submission. This skill routes feedback and drafts complete, redacted reports.
actual_capabilities: Classifies feedback as a bug, feature request, or open-ended question.
Routes concrete reports to GitHub and discussion requests to Prisma Discord.
Collects versions, environment details, reproduction steps, and expected behavior.
Drafts issue titles and bodies that match the repository issue forms.
Redacts secrets and confidential schema details before public sharing.
Submits through GitHub CLI only after explicit user confirmation.
limitations: It does not diagnose or fix application code before routing feedback.
It cannot guarantee a response from maintainers or Discord participants.
It depends on user-provided reproduction details and environment information.
GitHub CLI submission requires local authentication and explicit approval.

use_cases.title: Report a Reproducible Bug
use_cases.description: Prepare a redacted issue with versions, steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

use_cases.title: Request a Missing Capability
use_cases.description: Turn a workflow gap into a focused feature request with scope, impact, and alternatives.
use_cases.target_user: Technical leads planning Prisma Next adoption

use_cases.title: Ask the Prisma Team
use_cases.description: Route an integration or design question to Discord with a concise opening message.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Feedback Channel
prompt_templates.prompt: Decide whether this Prisma Next feedback belongs in GitHub, Discord, or another workflow skill: [describe the situation].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner routing for an uncertain question

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Bug Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a public-safe Prisma Next bug report from these details: [version, environment, command, output, steps, expected result, actual result].

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Feature Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Prisma Next feature request for [missing capability]. Include the problem, proposed behavior, alternatives, affected packages, and current workaround.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused proposal for a capability gap

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Coordinated Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [feedback details], separate bugs from feature requests, redact confidential content, draft each artifact, and request confirmation before any GitHub submission.

output_examples.input: Migration planning exits successfully even when no migration is generated.
output_examples.output: Recommended channel: GitHub bug report. Draft title: bug(cli): migration plan exits successfully without a generated migration. The body requests version and reproduction details.

output_examples.input: We need guidance for integrating an extension with an evolving Prisma Next API.
output_examples.output: Recommended channel: Prisma Discord. The draft opening message summarizes the integration, version, relevant API surface, and the specific compatibility question.

output_examples.input: Prisma Next needs a first-party build plugin, and the current workaround is manual.
output_examples.output: Recommended channel: GitHub feature request. The draft explains the workflow gap, desired plugin behavior, current workaround, package scope, and expected impact.

best_practices: Provide exact package, Node, package manager, operating system, and database versions.
Reduce bug reports to minimal steps and only the relevant contract excerpt.
Review every public artifact and confirm it before submission.
anti_patterns: Do not include credentials, customer data, or confidential schema names.
Do not combine a bug and a feature request in one issue.
Do not submit an issue automatically or without the user reviewing it.

faq.question: When should I use GitHub instead of Discord?
faq.answer: Use GitHub for reproducible bugs and concrete feature requests. Use Discord for questions, design feedback, and discussions requiring back-and-forth.

faq.question: Will the skill submit an issue automatically?
faq.answer: No. It presents the title and body, then requires explicit user confirmation before running GitHub CLI.

faq.question: What information is required for a bug report?
faq.answer: Provide Prisma Next, Node, package manager, operating system, and database versions, plus reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and relevant output.

faq.question: How does the skill protect sensitive information?
faq.answer: It removes connection strings, credentials, customer data, and confidential schema details before preparing any public artifact.

faq.question: Can it file feature requests?
faq.answer: Yes. It drafts the problem, proposed behavior, alternatives, package scope, impact, and current workaround.

faq.question: What happens when GitHub CLI is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill provides the official issue page and a rendered body that the user can review and paste manually.
